package.name: f1tenth_comms
package.description: The car side of the link to the base PC. link_manager sends a UDP heartbeat to the base (Tailscale first, the hotspot address as fallback), publishes OK/DEGRADED/LOST on /comms/link_status and, while LOST, asks NetworkManager to bring the hotspot profile up again (rate-limited). wifi_coverage_node maps Wi-Fi RSSI, round trip and loss per 1 m cell of the map frame, for this session only, as two latched OccupancyGrids. Reports only: nothing in the stack drives or stops on them. Setup and tests: output/comms/setup.md.
